notes: This file is a source/elevation contract for the current Alpine render anchors.
It is not a processed DEM output yet; render art must not claim final elevation accuracy until raster clips, hillshade masks and elevation-band polygons are produced.
Rendered Alpine anchors must be tied to these named massif records or later DEM-derived ridge records, never to random decorative placement.

primary.name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30
primary.license_note: Full, free and open Copernicus DEM 30m product; attribution and product terms must be checked before committing derived raster assets.

fallbacks.name: EU-DEM
fallbacks.license_note: Legacy European DEM context; use only if current Copernicus DEM access is unsuitable and attribution is documented.

fallbacks.name: NASA SRTM 1 Arc-Second Global
fallbacks.license_note: Fallback 1 arc-second elevation source distributed by USGS/NASA LP DAAC; attribution and access path must be recorded before derived assets are committed.

fallbacks.name: Natural Earth terrain or hypsometric context
fallbacks.license_note: Low-detail silhouette/context only; not sufficient for final Alpine validation.
